Predicates:
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college at Yale.
YaleUniversity(x) ::: x is Yale University.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
ValuedAt(x, y) ::: x is valued at y dollars.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
ListOfColleges(x) ::: x is a list of colleges.

Premises:
YaleUniversity(yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
LocatedIn(yale, newHaven) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
ValuedAt(yale, 42.3billion) ::: Yale University’s endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(yale, 27) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools.
ListOfColleges(benjaminFranklin, berkeley, branford, davenport, ezraStiles, graceHopper, jonathanEdwards, Morse, pauliMurray, pierson, saybrook, silliman, timothyDwight, trumbull) ::: List of residential colleges at Yale.

Conclusion:
ResidentialCollege(pierson) ::: Pierson College is a residential college at Yale.
